svg.title: 抽象主机:生成的解析器直接写入你自己的结构
svg.desc: Top, dim: the pattern to avoid - a socket buffer goes through a parser into a message object on the heap (copy 1), then through a mapper into your structures (copy 2), with a buffer the size of the whole message. Bottom: on an abstract host, a Block streams through a 1 KB receive buffer; one fill holds the sequence and window 1 of the samples, the next fill brings window 2. The generated parser calls your setters and the data lands in your ring buffer and your columns; a generated Block object is never created. Right: Capture.raw, a Stream of length-prefixed chunks ending with a zero length, flows into your sink; its length is unknown at the start and the S cap is checked on both sides. Footer: resident memory is a 1 KB send and a 1 KB receive buffer per connection plus a small parser state, whatever the pack size; a full sink stops socket reads so unread data waits in the network; 64 states of 3 bits take 24 bytes.

g.font-family: Segoe UI,Microsoft YaHei,PingFang SC,Noto Sans CJK SC,DejaVu Sans,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
g.text: 抽象主机:解析器写入你的结构
先解析再拷贝(应避免的模式)
每条消息一个对象,还要再维护一份同步的模型

text.tspan: 在主机上:每个 pack 都是覆于你对象之上的接口

g.text: 数组数据以缓冲区窗口的形式交出
常驻内存:两个缓冲区 + 少量解析器状态 ——
500 MB 采集与 64 字节 pack 开销相同
数据汇满了 → 套接字停止读取:
